correctness.rationale: Reconstructed feedback bijection and Hessian exactly, checked scalar derivative and interval clipping, proved unique half-angle minimax by monotonicity of sine-square on both sides of its peak, and realized sharpness with a three-eigenvalue diagonal matrix. The domain includes the singular A endpoint because every positive feedback shift is invertible. A standalone script passed 7,146 symbolic and finite tests; no infinite conclusion rests on a finite enumeration.

value.rationale: The natural spectral endpoints determine a unique complete minimax tuning rule for a known and useful matching-square/feedback Hessian. At alpha=1 and spectral interval [0,1], sharp conditioning improves from 2 at the conventional shift to 4-2sqrt(2) at the derived shift. The extremal three-mode realization and exact collapse of two-endpoint systems characterize why and when the guarantee is tight. The result is a complete structural classification, not a small arbitrary parameter slice or just another factor-two inequality.
